notes.title: Alpha 0.2a
notes.content:
Hello Mechanization Community,

Alpha 0.2a brings the Halloween update to Mechanization which includes:
[list]
[*] Pumpkin (Ore) - Sells for $6
[*] Pumpkin Dropper - Costs $4000, 30 RP to research and drops 2 pumpkins every 2 seconds
[*] A Halloween themed main menu
[*] Small bug fixes
[/list]
This event will run until [b]November 3rd 2023[/b]. Once it ends, any event droppers in your factories will stay however they can't be placed again.

notes.title: Less than 24 hours to go
notes.content:
There is less than 24 hours until Mechanization releases to early access!

[h3][b]Questions[/b][/h3]
[b]Q: How much will the game cost?[/b]
A: $9.00 US

[b]Q: What time tomorrow does the game release?[/b]
A: 6PM BST | 1PM ET

[b]Q: Where can I get the game for free?[/b]
A: We are going to be running giveaways in our [url=https://discord.gg/9XjwkyT6z5]Discord[/url] throughout the week of release.

[b]Q: What will come in the first EA update and when?[/b]
A: The first EA update will add rebirthing; there is no ETA on when that update will be released.

[h2]Be sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/9XjwkyT6z5]Discord[/url]  for giveaways, bug reporting, suggestions & more![/h2]

notes.title: MECHANIZATION - EARLY ACCESS
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2564440/Mechanization/][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2564440/extras/mechanization-full-banner.png?t=1693821797[/img][/url]

[h2]Mechanization is being released to early access on [b]October 5th 2023[/b].[/h2]

[h3]What will the early access version contain?[/h3]
On EA release, you can expect the following features:
[list]
[*] Droppers, Smelters, Conveyors, etc
[*] Electricity
[*] Progression System (Tech Tree)
[*] Airdrop System
[*] Decoration Objects
[*] Cloud Saves
[/list]

[h3]What features will be added throughout early access?[/h3]
I plan to add the following features during early access:
[list]
[*] More bug fixes & optimizations
[*] More items, droppers, machines, resources & progression balances
[*] Rebirth system and rarer items
[*] PvE events (AI) and factory defenses
[*] Lua modding API
[*] Multiplayer
[/list]
